items.statement: At least a third of adults receiving systemic therapy at the centre report moderate or severe financial toxicity, with higher prevalence among patients under 65 and those living more than 50 kilometres away.
items.rationale: Consistent with the retrieved multicentre survey; decides the size of a navigation service.

items.statement: The distress screening checkbox identifies fewer than two thirds of patients with moderate or severe financial toxicity.
items.rationale: A single item performed so elsewhere (claim c2).
items.risks: Checkbox completed at a different time from the questionnaire.

items.statement: Patients with moderate or severe financial toxicity more often report delaying or skipping treatment.

summary: Three hypotheses; h1 selected, h2 as the screening question.
